body.prompt: @Image1 sings @Audio1. Use @Image1 as the reference for her look, the set and the light. @Audio1 is her own voice and the whole soundtrack: copy it unchanged and add nothing. In @Audio1 she sings "the city wakes we count the windows"; her lips form each word as it sounds and rest closed in the silences. Close-up, she speaks the verse into the lens. One continuous shot, no cuts, no head turns. Only she sings. No text, letters or logos.
